summary: Creates the notification-area icon with a menu.
remarks: It needs no window: a tray-only application can create it. The icon and its menu run on a thread of their own.

summary: Creates thumbnails from the shell's thumbnail providers and cache, as Explorer shows them.
remarks: It needs no window. A file without a thumbnail provider gets no thumbnail, never its icon. Each request extracts on a single-threaded apartment thread of its own, a few at a time.
